notes: This contract covers the bounded recipient-side Convey Region Designator Sets behavior in the embedded development profile. Regional overlap routing remains independent from callback metadata: the receiver's switch is re-evaluated at callback entry, disabled delivery omits the optional Set of Sent Region Designators argument, and enabled delivery carries the sent update-region realization for the receive-order and timestamped interaction/reflection paths exercised by Catch2. The explicit-source timestamped re-enable companion confirms that this metadata remains attached to the queued callback across a Time Constrained disable/re-enable cycle. Default-region realization, conveyed-region ownership/use, directed interactions, remote transport, save/restore, package evidence, and conformance remain outside this slice.
